property_summary: After construction, calling `availableForFlashLoan` on the pool with the baseToken address as the token param returns false in the reference (since baseToken is not an ERC721) but returns ambiguous in the bug (since nft equals baseToken address), causing a revert difference when trying to check ownership.
change_summary: Swap the assignment of nft with baseToken, so nft gets the value of the _baseToken parameter.
